riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most reassuring part of this career is the stability of the financial system. When every cent reconciles and systems run smoothly, the order of a stable back office becomes a defining professional satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The work develops attention to detail and respect for rules. Every financial-market transaction follows defined procedures, and accurately reconciling a large settlement creates a distinctive sense of having kept the system stable.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Conventional C + Social S + Enterprising E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最踏实的是「金融体系里的安全感」：你把清算对得一分不差，系统运行平稳，这种「后台稳了」的秩序感，是金融人专属的职业底色。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练人的是「细心和规矩」：金融市场的每一笔交易都有章可循，你核对清楚一笔大额清算，心里那种「稳住了」的感觉，是金融后台人特有的踏实。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 常规型 C + 社会型 S + 企业型 E

breadcrumb.label: Buyers And Purchasing Agents, Farm Products

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who enjoy calculating and visiting markets. Securing quality goods at low prices and protecting profit through volatility gives every transaction a story at year-end.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The excitement comes from racing market conditions. Buy quality goods when prices are low and sell smoothly when prices rise. Savings become direct company profit. Travel and supplier relationships keep the work varied.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Conventional C + Investigative I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「喜欢算账、爱跑市场」的人——低价时囤到好货、行情起伏里为公司守住利润，年底算账的时候，你经手的每一分钱都有故事。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最刺激的是「跟行情赛跑」：行情低的时候低价囤货、行情高的时候顺利出货，一年下来为公司省下的钱都是实打实的利润。跑产地、见供应商，跟天南海北的农户打交道，职业生活从不单调。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

breadcrumb.label: Coin, Vending, And Amusement Machine Servicers And Repairers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work combines practicality, hands-on ability, and schematic reading. You must diagnose faults accurately, replace parts reliably, balance speed with quality, and work at height.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops a feel for machines and skill in reading diagrams. You need to interpret circuit schematics and error codes, disassemble equipment, and fit parts precisely. It suits practical, hands-on people who do not mind dirt or heights and enjoy restoring a machine's ability to operate and collect revenue.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, investigation, and following rules (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 动手 + 能读图」凑一块的人——故障要查得准，零件要换得稳，效率和靠谱要平衡也要会爬高。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手感和读图」——要能看电路图和报错码，也要拆得动、拧得准。适合务实、动手强、不怕脏和爬高的人，也享受「修好就又能收钱」的那一下。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、探究、也守规则（务实 R + 探究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who combine rational analysis, practical judgment, and field mobility. Energy use must be measured clearly, savings must be achievable, and safety must be balanced with investment.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work rewards practical calculation. Energy Auditors understand equipment, quantify efficiency, and present recommendations that owners will fund. It suits analytical people who can focus at a desk, visit field sites, and enjoy seeing a project move from survey to measured return.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, investigation, and practical business results (Realistic R + Investigative I + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「理性 + 实在 + 能跑腿」凑一块的人——能耗要算清也要省得动，安全和投入要平衡也要会算。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「算计里的实在」——既要懂设备和能效算得清，也要有把建议说到业主肯掏钱的分寸。适合理性、坐得住、又愿意跑现场的人，也享受从踏勘到回报的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、钻研、也务实（现实 R + 研究 I + 企业 E）。

breadcrumb.label: First Line Supervisors Of Housekeeping And Janitorial Workers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine awareness of the work, awareness of the crew, and on-site authority. Floors need to stay clean, shifts need full coverage, and operations need stability.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career requires noticing work while understanding people. If you ignore water on the floor, nobody cleans it; if you mishandle employee frustration, someone misses a shift. It suits people who manage responsibility, organize crews, and focus on repeated details. Interpersonal judgment is a core skill.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, leadership, and structured processes (Enterprising E + Realistic R + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 家政保洁工人一线主管

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「眼里有活 + 心里有人 + 能压场」凑一块的人——地要净，人要齐，场子要稳。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最吃「眼里有活、心里有人」——地上那摊水你不指出来就没人擦，手下人闹情绪你不顺就旷工。适合能扛事、会安排、也愿意在重复里抠细节的人，跟人打交道的分寸感是硬指标。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏向务实、管人、也讲流程（企业 E + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people who exchange exceptional patience for exceptional value. A millimeter under a magnifying lamp marks the boundary between handcraft and machinery.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal of this occupation lies in skill measured at tiny tolerances. A more accurate diamond cut can change brilliance by a full grade and double its value. People who enjoy precision, tolerate solitary practice, and take satisfaction in transforming rough stones can find a craftsperson's sense of achievement.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「以极致的耐心换极致的价值」的人——放大灯下的一毫米，是手艺和机器的分界线。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的魅力在于「毫厘之间见功夫」：一颗钻石切得准不准，光泽差一个等级，价值差一倍。喜欢精细、耐得住寂寞、享受把原石变成宝石的人，会在这里找到匠人式的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work best suits people who enjoy helping others solve problems in a calm setting. Helping a reader locate a long-sought book makes their thanks the day's most tangible reward.
riasec_fit_block.interest: One of the best parts of this work is engaging with knowledge every day. One reader seeks genealogy, another conducts research, and another simply shelters from rain with a book. Every question requires individual verification, gradually turning the librarian into a living research directory.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Investigative I + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 图书馆员与媒体馆藏专员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最适合「喜欢帮别人解决问题、又不爱闹腾」的人——帮读者找到他找了半天的那本书，对方的「谢谢」就是一天最实的回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最舒服的是「天天跟知识打交道」：每天都能遇到新问题——有人找族谱，有人做研究，有人只是来躲雨看书。图书馆不大，但每个问题都得单独查证，越做越像行走的检索目录。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 研究型 I + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you accept the environment and want tangible earnings, this work pays directly. More importantly, it is the lowest-cost ticket into a factory system, with opportunities waiting in the workshop for strong performers.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work has low barriers and direct income: no education is required, a few days of training prepares workers, and piece rates reward effort. More importantly, it is an entry into factory systems; many repairers, equipment operators, and line leaders started as feeders.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你不挑环境、只想实打实挣钱，这行来钱直接；更重要的是，它是进工厂体系最便宜的门票——干得好，机会在车间里等着你。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行门槛低、来钱直接：不需要学历，培训几天就能上岗，计件工资让肯干的人收入不错。更重要的是它是工厂体系的入口——很多机修工、设备操作工、线长都是从送料工干起来的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine sensitivity + love of writing + resilience to rejection. Words must feel true and withstand refinement, balancing emotion with rhythm and accepting revision.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops language sense. Writers must write well and understand why readers are moved. It suits sensitive people who study language and let rejection refine their work.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Creative, helpful, and thoughtful (Artistic A + Social S + Investigative I).

breadcrumb.label: 诗人、作词人创意写作者

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「敏感 + 爱写 + 能熬退稿」凑一块的人——字要真也要磨得动，情绪和节奏要平衡也要会改。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「语感」——既要会写，也要懂读者为什么被打动。适合敏感、爱琢磨字句、又愿意被退稿打磨的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好创造、助人、也思考（艺术 A + 社会 S + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about Solar Photovoltaic Installers and are comfortable making judgments under moderate risk, this occupation is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field particularly develops steady hands for work at height. You must read drawings, understand electrical safety, withstand climbing and sun exposure, and tighten every bolt correctly. It suits people who do not fear heights, follow safety rules, and work methodically.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, order, and taking the lead (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Solar Photovoltaic Installers有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，太阳能光伏安装工值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「高处作业的手稳」——既要读得懂图纸与电气安全，也要扛得住爬高与暴晒，还得把每一颗螺栓拧到位。适合不怕高、守安全、条理清楚的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、秩序、也主导（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine steadiness, attention to detail, and responsibility. Money must move smoothly, accounts must balance accurately, and rules and judgment must be balanced and explained clearly.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops command of numbers. Professionals must calculate cash flow and cost of capital accurately and explain accounts clearly to regulators and boards. It suits steady, detail-oriented people who accept responsibility and enjoy the full process from closing to disclosure.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: They prefer practical business management and order (Enterprising E + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「稳重 + 细致 + 责任感」凑一块的人——钱要转得顺、账要平得准，规矩和判断要平衡也要会讲。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「数字里的掌控感」——既要算得清现金流和资本成本，也要在监管和董事会之间把账讲明白。适合稳重、细致、又愿意对结果负责的人，也享受从结账到披露的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实经营与秩序（企业 E + 务实 R + 秩序 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about cabinetmaking and are comfortable making judgments under moderate risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops the ability to make wood cooperate. Craftspeople must understand drawings and the nature of wood, tolerate precision and repetition, and create beauty through grain and touch. It suits quiet, dexterous people with aesthetic judgment.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic, artistic, and conventional (Realistic R + Artistic A + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 橱柜制造工与台架木工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Cabinetmakers And Bench Carpenters有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，橱柜制造工与台架木工值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「让木头听话」——既要读得懂图纸也懂木性，也要耐得住精细与重复，还得在纹理与手感里做出美感。适合手巧、安静、有审美的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、创造、也秩序（现实 R + 艺术 A + 常规 C）。
